name: Red Light, Green Light Sprint
promptTemplate: A high-stakes Red Light Green Light arena in {{track_style}} style with a {{pace}}s signal rhythm under {{difficulty}} rules, featuring {{trails}} motion trails.

ui.title: SPRINT +2 TRAINER
ui.tagline: RUN ON GREEN, FREEZE ON RED

step.hint: Mash to dash forward on green; freeze on red

restart.hint: Reset all runners back to the start line

listing.blurb: Competitors sprint down a neon corridor toward a giant traffic beacon, mashing to step forward on green while freezing before red triggers a penalty.
listing.prompt: Red light, green light across a long playing field: a giant traffic light at the far end, and a figure for every person at the start line; while it is green each press of 'step' moves you forward, but pressing on red sends you back to the start; the first to reach the light wins. Make it a party game a whole room can follow from across the floor: bold shapes and bright colours on a dark ground, every player drawn in their own hue, big short labels (a score, GO!, the winner) in a heavy font, and a large, satisfying reaction on screen the instant anyone presses. It must work with one player or forty, scaling its lanes, seats or pieces to room.people and coping with people joining and leaving mid-round; play itself in a lively attract mode whenever nobody has pressed anything for a few seconds; and after a winner is shown, start the next round on its own. Keep it lean: game state in bounded arrays in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080.
